o: In Season Four, two marriages threaten to eat each other alive. One catastrophic moment shatters the fragile peace Kate Wyler brokered between the US and UK, as well as the crumbling marriage she's trying to save. eps.o: On an unplanned stopover at Windsor Castle, Kate grows wary of Hal and Grace's dynamic as she tries to contain the fallout from their covert actions.
A shocking security breach sends the administration into crisis as Hal assumes new duties. Trowbridge launches a manhunt, and Kate looks to the future.
A budgetary snag threatens to torpedo negotiations, with costly implications for the US. Stuart and Eidra get personal as they weigh their next move.
After Hal drops a bombshell that throws the UK alliance into jeopardy, Kate faces mounting pressure to control the damage by any means necessary.
Kate contends with her complicity in a stunning political shake-up, while a disenchanted Todd explores his options across the pond.
When a dangerous adversary makes its move, Grace issues a hard-line threat to the prime minister, forcing Kate to reckon with her role as the messenger.
Personal and political lives collide — and damaging secrets surface — when Kate and Hal join Grace and Todd in Italy ahead of the G7 summit.
At a meeting of world leaders, a diplomatic breakdown edges the US closer to an international crisis — and compels Kate to make a seismic decision.
